'''Star Tours Flight 101''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Empress Teta/Legends|Empress Teta]] just before the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]]. It experienced a gate change to Gate 3D and it was expected to arrive at the spaceport at 1755 hours. It was scheduled to depart again at 1850.
